title: A Difficult Conversation With a Friend
summaryZh: 一個人終於向老是放鴿子的朋友攤牌，才發現對方正瞞著失業的難處。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I've been putting this off for weeks, and I think if I don't say it now I never will.
sentences.zh: 這件事我拖了好幾個禮拜，我覺得再不說，大概就永遠說不出口了。
sentences.note: putting 的 tt 在母音間變閃音 /ˈpʊ.ɾɪŋ/；this off 連讀，s 直接連到母音。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That's an alarming way to start a conversation, so you might as well just come out with it.
sentences.zh: 這種開場滿嚇人的，那你乾脆直接講吧。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: You've canceled on me four times since March, usually the same afternoon we were supposed to meet.
sentences.zh: 從三月到現在你放我鴿子四次，而且多半是約好見面的當天下午。
sentences.note: canceled on 的 d 連到 on 的母音；supposed to 縮成 /sə.ˈpoʊs.tə/。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I know how that sounds, and I'm not going to sit here and pretend it isn't a pattern.
sentences.zh: 我知道這聽起來是什麼樣子，我也不會坐在這裡假裝那不是一種習慣。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: I'm not keeping score for the sake of it, but at some point I stopped making plans at all.
sentences.zh: 我不是刻意在記帳，但到了某個時候，我根本就不再約你了。
sentences.note: at some point 的 t 都不爆破；stopped making 的 t 在 m 前完全脫落。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: That's fair, and honestly I noticed you'd gone quiet, which I told myself was just a busy stretch.
sentences.zh: 這說得沒錯，老實說我有注意到你變安靜了，只是我告訴自己你只是比較忙。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: It wasn't, and I think you knew that, which is part of why this has been sitting on me.
sentences.zh: 並不是，而且我覺得你心裡有數，這也是為什麼這件事一直壓著我。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: There's stuff going on that I haven't told anybody, and it's easier to cancel than to explain it.
sentences.zh: 有些事我沒跟任何人講過，取消比解釋容易多了。
sentences.note: There's stuff 兩個 s 疊在一起只發一個較長的 /s/；haven't told 的 t 被後面的 t 吸收。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: Then explain it to me now, because I'd much rather hear something difficult than sit here guessing.
sentences.zh: 那你現在就跟我說，因為我寧願聽到難聽的事，也不想坐在這裡亂猜。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I lost the contract in January, and I've been burning through savings while pretending everything's fine.
sentences.zh: 我一月就丟了那個案子，一直在燒存款，還裝作一切都好。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's a lot to carry on your own, and I wish you'd let me in months ago.
sentences.zh: 一個人扛這些太重了，我真希望你幾個月前就讓我知道。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: I didn't want the friendship to turn into me showing up and unloading on you every week.
sentences.zh: 我不想讓這段友情變成我每週跑來找你倒垃圾。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's not how this works, and frankly you don't get to decide what I can handle.
sentences.zh: 友情不是這樣運作的，而且說真的，我能承受多少不是你來決定。
sentences.note: don't get to 的 don't 要重讀，是對比重音，強調對方無權替我決定。

sentences.speaker: B
sentences.text: Point taken, so here's what I can promise: I'll tell you when I'm not up for it instead of vanishing.
sentences.zh: 我聽進去了，我能答應的是：我狀態不好的時候會直接跟你說，而不是人間蒸發。

sentences.speaker: A
sentences.text: That's all I wanted, and for what it's worth, I'd have taken a bad night over four months of silence.
sentences.zh: 我要的就只是這樣，而且說真的，我寧願陪你度過一個糟糕的夜晚，也不要四個月的沉默。
sentences.note: I'd have 口語縮成 /ˈaɪ.ɾəv/；a bad night 和 four months 是一組對比重音。

questions.q: What has been damaging the friendship?
options: B repeatedly canceling plans at the last minute
An argument about money B borrowed
Something B said about A's job
B was avoiding having to explain losing a contract
B had quietly moved to another city
B was still angry about an old argument

questions.q: How does A react when B says he didn't want to be a burden?
options: A agrees that it was considerate
A rejects B's right to decide that for him
A asks for some space to think
